# DXT UI

> Modular Vue 3 UI library, design system constructor, Figma tooling, and AI-automated documentation monorepo.

DXT UI is an ecosystem for building enterprise-grade Vue 3 applications and design systems with strict TypeScript typing, headless constructor architecture, SCSS design tokens, and automated AI documentation workflows.

## Documentation & Links

- [Official Documentation](https://dxtmisha.github.io/dxt-ui/): Interactive Storybook documentation, guides, and component playgrounds.
- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/dxtmisha/dxt-ui): Source code, issues, and monorepo workspace structure.

## Core Packages

- [d1](packages/d1/llms.txt): Production-ready Vue 3 component library (100+ components, design tokens, Vite plugin).
- [constructor](packages/constructor/llms.txt): Headless class-based component constructors, state logic engines, and ARIA accessibility controllers.
- [styles](packages/styles/llms.txt): SCSS design system tokens, dynamic CSS variable engine (`--sys-*`), and responsive mixins.
- [functional](packages/functional/llms.txt): Reactive Vue 3 utilities, composables, API orchestration (`useApiRef`), and state singletons (`executeUse`).
- [functional-basic](packages/functional-basic/llms.txt): Framework-agnostic isomorphic utility library (HTTP client, storage, i18n, SEO meta, DOM helpers).
- [ui](packages/ui/llms.txt): Meta-package bundling all core DXT UI packages into a single dependency.

## Ecosystem & Tooling Packages

- [configuration](packages/configuration/llms.txt): Shared Vite and TypeScript configuration presets for building UI packages.
- [scripts](packages/scripts/llms.txt): CLI tools, component scaffolding, AI prompt processing, screenshot captures, and barrel exports.
- [wiki](packages/wiki/llms.txt): Storybook documentation toolkit, argTypes builders (`WikiStorybook`), and MDX documentation system.
- [media](packages/media/llms.txt): 250+ vector SVG country flags and ISO 3166-1 country dataset.
- [nitro-basic](packages/nitro-basic/llms.txt): SSR bootstrapping utilities and state synchronization for Vue 3 and Nitro.
- [zip](packages/zip/llms.txt): Lightweight ZIP archive creation and browser download management based on fflate.
- [test](packages/test/llms.txt): Vue 3 UI test harnesses, test containers, and visual regression fixtures.
- [mcp](packages/mcp/llms.txt): Model Context Protocol (MCP) server implementations and tools for design system integration.

## Figma Synchronization Packages

- [figma](packages/figma/llms.txt): Core bidirectional messaging middleware between Figma plugin sandbox and iframe UI.
- [figma-code](packages/figma-code/llms.txt): TypeScript backend abstraction for Figma plugins (node traversal, persistent storage, design tokens).
- [figma-ref](packages/figma-ref/llms.txt): Reactive Vue 3 composables for Figma plugin UI (`useFigmaStorage`, `useFigmaFrameSelection`).
- [figma-style](packages/figma-style/llms.txt): Figma DevMode plugin for style, token, and layout extraction.
- [figma-translate](packages/figma-translate/llms.txt): Figma plugin for automated text translation and codegen localization.

## Applications & Development

- [demo](packages/demo/llms.txt): Sandbox playground and SSR/CSR demonstration application.
- [storybook](packages/storybook/llms.txt): Storybook development and build environment.

## Optional

- [README](README.md): Project overview and quick start guide.
